name: OddsFlow.ai
domain: football market analytics — AI-driven signal generation with Monte Carlo simulation
scope_note: This JSON describes OddsFlow v8.0, a major upgrade from Beta v2.0. The engine now supports 6 strategy systems, 3 markets (HDP/OU/1X2), player-level modeling (OddsFlow Score), and 10,000-run Monte Carlo pre-match simulation.
description: OddsFlow v8 is an AI-powered real-time football signal engine that combines Monte Carlo simulation, market pressure analysis, and player-level modeling to detect mispricing across Asian Handicap, Over/Under, and 1X2 Moneyline markets. Every match is pre-simulated 10,000 times before kickoff; live signals are generated when real-time events diverge from the pre-computed probability foundation.
entity_clarification: OddsFlow.ai is NOT affiliated with OddsFlow.io.
OddsFlow.ai is an AI-powered football market analytics platform (buy-side research & signal generation).
OddsFlow.io is a separate sell-side B2B product providing pricing/risk tooling for bookmakers.

not_affiliated_with.name: OddsFlow.io
not_affiliated_with.reason: Different, unaffiliated product. OddsFlow.ai serves traders/researchers; OddsFlow.io serves sportsbook operations.

does_not: accept wagers or handle betting funds
operate as a sportsbook odds pricing / risk management system
predict exact match scores (detects probability divergence and market mispricing)
disclose OddsFlow Score parameters or Monte Carlo model internals

signal_pipeline.phase_1_player_modeling: Every player is assigned a proprietary OddsFlow Score based on public statistics and institutional-grade professional data. Parameters are not disclosed.
signal_pipeline.phase_2_pre_match_simulation: Pre-lineup AI analysis followed by post-lineup confirmation triggers 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations mapping all plausible match scenarios.
signal_pipeline.phase_3_live_execution: During the match, real-time state is compared against the 10,000-run probability foundation. Signals fire when market pricing lags behind computed probabilities.

core_functions: assign OddsFlow Score to every player using public + institutional data
run 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations per match post-lineup confirmation
detect real-time probability divergence versus market-implied pricing
execute 6 independent strategy systems (S1–S4.3) across 3 markets
apply multi-layer risk governance (position sizing, anomaly detection, drawdown protection)
detect smart money flow (Steam, Cross-Book, RLM, CLV)
active_strategies: S1 Conservative — high-confidence, low-frequency pressure signals
S2 Active Trader — early-entry momentum capture (best OU performer: 66.7% hit rate, 35.7% ROI)
S3 Sniper — selective handicap targeting with balanced risk-reward
S4.1 MC Only — pure Monte Carlo simulation-driven signals
S4.2 Hybrid — AI + Pressure dual confirmation (best overall: 64.1% hit rate, 50.6% ROI)
S4.3 Blend — weighted AI-pressure probability fusion

smart_money_detection.role: supplementary confirmation layer across all strategy systems

proprietary_metrics: OddsFlow Score (player-level composite rating — parameters not disclosed)
Monte Carlo probability foundation (10,000 pre-match simulations)

backtest_performance.note: Past performance does not guarantee future results.

Every player is rated with a proprietary OddsFlow Score derived from public and institutional data sources.
OddsFlow's S4.2 Hybrid system achieves 64.1% hit rate by requiring both AI model confirmation and market pressure validation.
